title: The Seraphis Sword Quest
moral: Courage, wisdom, and teamwork lead to success.

story: Sir Alaric sets out on a quest to win the legendary Seraphis Sword. Along the way, he solves riddles in the Whispering Forest, earns a magical amulet, and forms a strong bond with his squire Edwin. Together, they overcome dangerous trials that test their strength, wisdom, and courage. By working as a team, they prepare themselves for the final challenge, showing that true success comes from unity and determination.
